evidence.text: The entry identifies 這 as the traditional counterpart of 这 and records 魚變切. It says 這 does not occur in oracle-bone or bronze inscriptions or in Shuowen; its account treats the original demonstrative use as a pronoun for nearer time, place, or thing, cites a Tang Lu Tong example with 這回, and cites a Yuan drama example where 這 functions as an empty metrical filler. These examples document uses, but do not establish a semantic link from the separate older verb ‘meet/receive’ to the demonstrative.
